technical.summary: Short-term bullish momentum (RSI9, AO, Ichimoku) with strong confluence in 9-50 period, but intermediate downtrend (below 200MA) and overbought conditions limit swing entry probability; suitable for tactical scalp only.

fundamental.summary: IP shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 22 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for IP; congressional activity is mixed and dated (5+ months old), market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 215 crisis regime, negative macro score) combined with earnings in 22 days creates severe risk environment for Materials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum confluence (RSI9 73, AO cross-up, Ichimoku TK cross above cloud) with price near support (31.41) offers tactical entry for scalp-only trade with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate downtrend (price below 200MA/50SMA), overbought conditions with pullback risk, zero fundamental/smart-money conviction, high earnings risk in 22 days, and extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, credit spreads) make risk/reward heavily unfavourable.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum confluence (RSI9 73, AO cross-up, Ichimoku TK cross) offers tactical entry near support; however, intermediate downtrend below 200MA and overbought conditions severely limit probability of sustained swing move.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 22 days combined with extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime, credit spreads elevated) creates uncompensated tail risk; overbought technicals increase pullback probability before earnings.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical momentum insufficient to overcome fundamental vacuum, smart money absence, and macro headwinds
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding IP position with 45 open Materials positions (10% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further; skip to preserve capital in unfavourable macro regime.
